youtube.baslik: Why does the bass disappear when music is turned down? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Equal-loudness contours show that at low levels the ear is much less sensitive to low-pitched sounds: for 40 phons, about 64 dB SPL is needed at 100 Hz but only 40 dB SPL at 1000 Hz. As level rises, the contours flatten, so bass seems to vanish when music is quiet and returns when it is turned up.
